The stay

Everything a hotel does, quietly.

No lobby, no queue, no upsell at the desk. What is included is written down before you book — and what costs extra is written down too.

Included in every stay

  • Fresh linen, towels & toiletries
  • A kitchen you can really cook in
  • Fast Wi-Fi and a proper workspace
  • Self check-in from 15:00
  • Parking, where the home lists it
  • Your host on WhatsApp throughout

On request

  • Airport transfer
  • Private chef for an evening
  • Groceries in the fridge on arrival
  • Extra housekeeping visits
  • Cot, high chair & baby gate
  • Late check-out, when the calendar allows

Extras are priced by the host before you agree to anything — the reply with your estimate lists them, so the total is never a surprise.

Why book direct

You talk to the host, not a call centre.

Questions

Before you ask us

How does booking work?

Pick your dates on a home’s page and you will see an estimate straight away. “Request to book” opens WhatsApp with the home, dates and estimate already written — you just press send. The host confirms availability and the final price, and your stay is held once the deposit is paid.

What does the estimate include?

The estimate is the nightly rate multiplied by your nights — nothing hidden inside it. Tourism Dirham and 5% VAT apply to every holiday home in Dubai and are added in the host’s confirmation, so you see the full total before you pay anything.

What are the check-in and check-out times?

Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is until 11:00. Early check-in and late check-out are free when the calendar allows — ask on WhatsApp and the host will tell you honestly.

Is there a deposit?

Yes — a refundable security deposit, confirmed by the host in writing before any payment. It is returned after check-out once the home has been checked, usually within a few days.

What if my plans change?

Free cancellation until 14 days before check-in, and a 50% refund until 7 days before. Inside 7 days the stay is non-refundable. The host confirms these terms on WhatsApp before you pay, in plain words.

Can I ask a question before booking?

Of course — that is the point of booking direct. Message us on WhatsApp any time; a person replies within the hour between 8:00 and 22:00, every day.

Your dates, your home.

Tell us when you are coming. We will show you the estimate for every home that fits — and the host, not a platform, will confirm it.
